terminals.name: bot
terminals.description: Runs the Telegram bot (polling) + admin panel. Requires a real TOKEN/OWNER_ID in .env; with the placeholder token it prints instructions and drops to a shell.
terminals.command: cd /workspace && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && if [ "${TOKEN}" = "0000000000:DEV_PLACEHOLDER_TOKEN_REPLACE_ME" ]; then echo 'TOKEN is a placeholder — set a real Telegram bot TOKEN and OWNER_ID in .env, then run: python run.py'; exec bash; else exec python run.py; fi
